title: Astraeus activity profile
description: One activity, declared rather than coded. A profile names the field families it reads, the thresholds and weights it applies to them, the hard stops that answer on their own, the astronomical window it is evaluated over, what it needs from a site, and the fields no admitted source can supply. Adding an activity is adding one of these files. No key skips validation: additionalProperties is false at every level, so a flag invented to bypass the checks is itself a validation failure.

id.description: Stable profile id, equal to the file stem. The id is what a score's provenance names, so it never changes with the title.

version.description: Bumped whenever a family, threshold, weight, hard stop or window rule changes, so 'which profile produced this score' has an answer in version control.

title.description: The human name. Never used as an identifier.

families.description: Field catalogue family names. A profile asks for families, not members: the decision layer chooses the member and carries its comparability note.

thresholds.description: Named thresholds a hard stop or a graded criterion refers to. Every threshold declares a default; a reader override is recorded in score provenance and never edited into this file.

weights.description: Criterion weights in [0, 1]. Hard stops carry no weight by construction.

hard_stops.description: Evaluated first and answering on their own. A hard stop whose field is absent is reported unknown, never as a pass.

graded_criteria.description: Evaluated only when no hard stop is in force. No field may appear both here and in hard_stops.

blocked_fields.description: Fields the profile would read that no admitted source can supply, listed by key with the reason. Listed explicitly so the absence is disclosed rather than omitted; a key the catalogue carries does not belong here.

wanted_not_catalogued.description: Quantities the profile's owner named that the field catalogue does not yet carry. Disclosed rather than dropped, so the gap is visible to a reader and to the next catalogue revision.

name.description: Project key style: snake case, level suffix for height fields.

default.description: Required. A threshold with no default fails validation, because a score with no stated default has nothing to record an override against.

units.description: Must equal the catalogue units of the field. Declared here so a unit disagreement is a build failure rather than a silent factor of 3.6.

comparison.description: Which side of the threshold triggers. Named rather than implied by sign.

weight.description: Names a key of weights, not a number: the numbers live in one place so a reader can read the whole weighting at once.

window.description: The window is an astronomical quantity, computed by the registered DE442 entry. A wall-clock or local-time rule would be a second, unregistered solar model, so the params of every rule are closed and no clock key is among them.

geometry_entry.description: The one registered ephemeris entry. A profile may not name another solar model.

geometry_fields.description: Outputs of the DE442 entry. When one is absent the window is unresolved with the field named, never guessed.

siteNeeds.description: What the profile needs from a site. Preferred and never limiting: a request naming no site is answered at the point, with the horizon absent rather than the evaluation refused.

sectors.description: Parameter sets of the registered sector-sampling entry. A sector is a derivation, not a query option, so its bearing and width are declared here and land in the provenance.

reason.description: The three refusals. Blocked is a state with a reason, never a null dressed up as one.

terms.description: The terms or notice that forbids it, named or quoted. This is the useful part of the refusal.

request.description: An outstanding permission or credential request, or null where none has been made.
